product_summary: Ahmedabad (Gujarat) filter manufacturer, ISO 9001:2015, established 2002. Real product lines per own website anandfilters.com (home + /products/): (1) filters for compressors - air filters, oil filters, air-oil separators, spin-on separators, screw compressor parts, replacement filters for Atlas Copco / Ingersoll Rand / ELGI; (2) hydraulic filters - filter housings and replacement elements for HYDAC, Parker, Atlas Copco, Internormen, Rexroth; (3) panel filters - box type, HEPA, flange filters and components; (4) dust collector cartridges for dry dust. Declared applications: ceramics, dairy/food & beverage, mining, power plant, pharma & biotech, refineries, steel, petrochemicals, oil & gas, chemical, cement.
comment: HS 842131 = intake air filters for internal combustion engines. The declared code is only PARTIALLY correct: it covers the engine/compressor intake air filter line, but the bulk of the catalogue is not engine intake filters. Correct HS-6 mapping from the actual product list: 842123 - oil filters / fuel filters for engines and compressors (oil filter, spin-on separator lines); 842129 - other liquid filtering/purifying machinery (hydraulic filter elements and housings, air-oil separators, oil separators); 842139 - other gas filtering/purifying machinery (panel/box/HEPA/flange air filters, dust collector cartridges); 842199 - parts of filtering machinery (replacement elements, filter components, compressor parts). Note: 842131 remains valid only for the intake-air-filter subset; the declaration is incomplete rather than wrong, so per Rule 3 the company is kept and the code set is corrected/expanded. INDUSTRY MISCLASSIFICATION: declared industry 'Металлургия и горнодобыча' (metallurgy & mining) is wrong - the company is a filter/filtration-equipment manufacturer (machinery, ch.84); mining and steel appear only as END-USER application sectors on the site, not as its own output. TRADER SIGNS: the site itself states 'Established in the year 2002 as a Manufacturer, Supplier and Trader' and it sells replacement filters for third-party brands (Atlas Copco, Ingersoll Rand, ELGI, HYDAC, Parker, Internormen, Rexroth) - i.e. mixed manufacturer/trader, hence role_hint manufacturer_trader. PRODUCT LINES MISSING FROM DECLARATION: hydraulic filter housings, HEPA/panel filters, dust collector cartridges, air-oil separators, compressor spare parts - none of these are covered by 842131. All product data above is from the company's own website only; no customs line was available to me in this task, therefore the entire product range is 'заявлено, не подтверждено' (declared, not confirmed). No registry, revenue or shipment research was performed per role scope. Legal name 'MAHENDRABHAI LAHERCHAND SHAH' as proprietor/partner could not be corroborated on the website (site gives no legal-entity details) - null.
